items.stem: A firm wants to check whether the mean life of bulbs (hours) differs from 330. Write H₀ and H₁ and state the type of test.
A sample of 25 items has mean 224.8. Can it be regarded as drawn from a population with mean 220 and SD 20 at the 5% level of significance (two-tailed)?
items.markingKey: H₀: μ = 220, H₁: μ ≠ 220 (1 mark); z = (x̄ − μ)/(σ/√n) = (224.8 − 220)/4 = 1.2 (1 mark); critical value 1.96: do not reject H₀ (1 mark).
